entry.name: syncAllDocks
entry.label: Use this dock's look and size settings on every Glossy Dock (pins stay per dock)

entry.name: showOpenApps
entry.label: Show apps that are open but not pinned after the pinned apps

entry.name: iconSize
entry.label: Icon size in pixels; 0 sizes icons to fit the panel

entry.name: evenIconSizes
entry.label: Draw icons that have built-in empty space larger, so all icons look the same size

entry.name: zoomPercent
entry.label: How much the hovered icon grows, in percent; 0 turns magnification off

entry.name: neighbourZoomPercent
entry.label: How much the icons next to the hovered one grow, in percent

entry.name: dockHeight
entry.label: Thickness of the dock's panel in pixels; 0 leaves it as set in Plasma

entry.name: showPreviews
entry.label: Show window previews when hovering an open app

entry.name: peekWindows
entry.label: Hide other windows while hovering a window preview

entry.name: showNameTooltips
entry.label: Show the app name when hovering an app without previews

entry.name: showLabels
entry.label: Always show app names under the icons

entry.name: dimMinimized
entry.label: Dim the icons of minimized apps

entry.name: debugLog
entry.label: Log which apps the dock shows (for troubleshooting and tests; no settings page)
